sections.title: Three new nouns, three harmony choices
sections.content: rendőrség ("police, police station"), színház ("theatre") and szobor ("statue") give -hoz/-hez/-höz a fresh workout — one back, one back, one front unrounded, so you have to actually check each word rather than guess from a pattern.

items.english: We're going to the police station.

items.spanish: Anna ma este a színházhoz megy.
items.english: Anna is going to the theatre this evening.

sections.content: rendőrség looks like it should be back-vowel because of the -ő-, but the suffix is chosen by the word's very last vowel — é, front unrounded — so it's rendőrséghez, not rendőrséghoz. Checking the last vowel, not the whole word, is the reliable habit here.
